behavior: The worker and signer binaries hold only startup and their loop; per-round chain RPC upkeep lives in internal packages
acceptance: cmd/worker/main.go and cmd/signer/main.go hold config, startup, the poll loop and shutdown only; the worker round (pick RPCs, scan, ledger, re-pick after errors) is internal/worker; the signer round (serve enabled chains, drop disabled ones, re-pick after a failed run) is settlement.Rounds.
Same behavior and logs: backend tests and the binary e2e gate pass; lint, typecheck, unit, build and e2e pass.
notes: 2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: Behavior matches main step for step. Worker: same Enabled read and error log, same unknown-chain and pick-RPCs logs with chain.Redact, same RoundTimeout per chain, same re-pick of one chain after a scan or ledger error, Close equals the old closeAll. Signer: still returns without sending when the enabled list read fails (log 'signer round skipped', redacted) and main still waits PollInterval after it; still drops disabled chains, dials missing ones on Primary, closes and forgets every chain after a failed Run, and closes all on exit (now also deletes map entries, harmless). Deleting from a map while ranging over it is safe in Go; close(id) is only called for keys present in rpcs. cmd files hold config, startup, loop and shutdown only. worker.New returns *worker.Worker and settlement.NewRounds returns *Rounds, both per naming rules; no new interfaces; internal/chain imports no forwend package, so no cycle. rules.md layout lists worker/. go build, go vet and pnpm --filter @forwend/backend test pass. Nit: exported type worker.Worker has no doc comment.

proof.1: backend: cmd/worker/main.go builds worker.New(pool, specs, keys) and loops Round/PollInterval; cmd/signer/main.go builds settlement.NewRounds(pool, key, specs, keys) and loops Round/wait; the round bodies moved unchanged into internal/worker/worker.go and internal/settlement/rounds.go
proof.2: backend-e2e: go test (race) passes, including TestSignerSkipsChainsItDoesNotServe; the e2e gate runs the real worker and signer binaries end to end (open, detected, paid, settled)
